reason: Claim c1 (accuracy failure over the legal domain) was tested exhaustively: since the contract admits every finite FP16 value (1..131072 elements, including signed zeros, subnormals, and extrema ±65504), I ran the kernel on all 63,488 finite FP16 values and compared against FP64 torch.sin (tool event t6). Max absolute error was 1.34e-7 at x=64512, with 0 violations of the 1e-6 tolerance. The output is FP32, fresh, on the input device, and the kernel preserves the input. No other failure mode is possible within the declared domain.
